title: Elvarika's Browser Tab Becomes a Real Android App | vitalii.no
description:
Elvarika existed only as a website. Playing an audio lesson meant keeping a browser tab alive in the background, with no way to play, pause, skip or stop from the phone's lock screen — exactly the moment most people reach for their phone, mid-walk or mid-commute.

Added an android/ module built on a Trusted Web Activity shell with a WebView fallback, verified against the app's signing fingerprint through a well-known assetlinks file. Two GitHub Actions workflows handle the build: one compiles the APK, the other runs it end-to-end against an emulator. The player component now wires the Media Session API so play, pause, next-track and stop all reach the lock screen. A publish script grabs the latest CI-built APK and uploads it to a storage bucket, and the site's /android path redirects straight to the download.

Elvarika now installs like a native Android app with working lock-screen playback controls, and every push to main can produce a freshly signed, emulator-tested APK — zero manual steps, zero Play Store review required.
